---
title: "Backtop"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
source(file.path("..", "..", "shots.R"))
```

A button to back to top.

## Basic Usage

Scroll down to see the bottom-right button.

```{r basic, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE}
tagList(
  "Scroll down to see the bottom-right button.",
  el_backtop(right = 100, bottom = 100)
)
```

## Customizations

Display area is 40px \* 40px.

```{r custom, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE}
tagList(
  "Scroll down to see the bottom-right button.",
  el_backtop(
    bottom = 100,
    content = tags$div(
      style = paste(
        "height: 100%; width: 100%; background-color: var(--el-bg-color-overlay);",
        "box-shadow: var(--el-box-shadow-lighter); text-align: center; line-height: 40px;",
        "color: #1989fa"
      ),
      "UP"
    )
  )
)
```

## API

Element Plus's tables, and beside each entry where it is in R.

```{r api, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
api_tables("backtop")
```
